record.original_question: Develop a general theory of k-orbit realizations of m-orbit polytopes, allowing the realized geometric object to have k flag orbits even when the underlying abstract polytope has m flag orbits.

evidence.quote: Problem 33. Develop a theory of k-orbit realizations of m-orbit polytopes.

artifact.status_search_result: The problem is posed as an open research direction in the list of open problems on k-orbit polytopes. Existing literature treats specific cases (regular and 2-orbit realizations, finite 3-orbit polyhedra in ordinary space, symmetry type graphs and coset-geometry characterizations of k-orbit polytopes), but no general theory of k-orbit realizations of m-orbit polytopes appears to have been developed.
